content.text:
Added a **New folder** affordance to the folder browser used by the new-project dialog.

**What changed** — [`apps/app/src/components/dialogs/RemotePathBrowser.tsx`](apps/app/src/components/dialogs/RemotePathBrowser.tsx):
- A folder-plus button in the browser toolbar (next to "Edit path") opens an inline name row at the top of the listing.
- Enter or the check button creates the folder on the selected host via the existing `POST /api/v1/files/mkdir` route (`sdk.files.mkdir`); Escape or the X cancels.
- On success it navigates into the new folder, so it immediately becomes the picked path and the dialog's derived project name updates. The parent listing is invalidated so the folder shows up when you navigate back up.
- Failures (e.g. name already exists, permission denied) render inline under the input instead of navigating.
- Names are validated client-side: non-empty, not `.`/`..`, no slashes — so a name can't silently create somewhere other than the folder you're looking at. Path joining infers the host's separator from the path string, matching how `toBreadcrumb` already handles POSIX vs Windows.

No server or daemon changes were needed — the mkdir route and `host.mkdir` RPC already existed, so no `HOST_DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION` bump. This is the app's first frontend consumer of `sdk.files.mkdir`.

med right — same act of choosing a folder — but say the word if you want it limited to the create flow.
